verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented plugin, skill, or tool format that a developer could write against and load locally. Custom agents only configure system prompts, personas, models, and tool selection from Khoj's built-in set. A community user even asked for an easily extended data connector interface, which suggests no such extension mechanism was available.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally
